question.en: Discuss the significance of the National IPR Policy 2016 in fostering an innovation-driven economy in India.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the National IPR Policy 2016 in fostering an innovation-driven economy in India.

structure.en: Define IPR and the need for a policy.
structure.hi: Define IPR and the need for a policy.

introduction.en: The National IPR Policy 2016 was launched to create a robust IPR ecosystem in India, aiming to stimulate creativity and innovation.
introduction.hi: The National IPR Policy 2016 was launched to create a robust IPR ecosystem in India, aiming to stimulate creativity and innovation.

body.en: The policy focuses on seven objectives: IPR awareness, generation, legal framework, administration, commercialization, enforcement, and human capital development. It emphasizes 'Creative India; Innovative India' and aims to streamline the patent filing process.
body.hi: The policy focuses on seven objectives: IPR awareness, generation, legal framework, administration, commercialization, enforcement, and human capital development. It emphasizes 'Creative India; Innovative India' and aims to streamline the patent filing process.

conclusion.en: By strengthening the IPR regime, India can attract more FDI and encourage domestic R&D, ultimately transitioning towards a knowledge-based economy.
conclusion.hi: By strengthening the IPR regime, India can attract more FDI and encourage domestic R&D, ultimately transitioning towards a knowledge-based economy.
